page: Amazon Web Services r8in.48xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System. Its processing capacity is delivered by Intel x86_64 architecture running at 3.9 GHz, providing 192 dedicated virtual CPUs across 96 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory totals 1536.0 GB, establishing a high-density allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU without hardware-based GPU acceleration.

Storage configuration on the r8in.48xlarge relies entirely on external network resources, as no local instance storage is present. Network performance is provisioned with a 300 Gbps baseline bandwidth, supporting high-throughput data transfers between instance memory, networked storage, and distributed cluster nodes. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The vast memory capacity paired with 300 Gbps baseline networking positions this server for memory-bound tasks requiring significant network input and output. The architectural tradeoff of omitting local disks requires workloads to leverage network-attached storage architectures. This resource profile is suited for enterprise in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, large-scale extract-transform-load (ETL) processing, and enterprise resource planning systems.
